jobs.description:
Operational Excellence Engineer (m/f/d)

Shape the future of manufacturing at Kelvion in Herne as an Operational Excellence Engineer and drive real, measurable improvements across our operations. You will identify and implement optimization opportunities using Lean, Continuous Improvement, and Operational Excellence methods such as 5S, Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis, and Gemba Walks. This is a high‑impact role where you directly influence efficiency, costs, and sustainability in a growing, technologically advanced industrial environment.

Your Role

- Lead Operational Excellence projects independently in close cooperation with all departments, including savings identification and cost analysis.
- Integrate improvements into daily operations with a strong shopfloor focus and ensure sustainable implementation.
- Moderate workshops and cross‑functional initiatives, and train and coach employees in OPX methods and tools.
- Perform value‑stream analyses, derive action plans, and report project progress, savings, and OPX successes.
- Collaborate across sites to create synergies and foster a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.

Attractive Offer & Environment

- Competitive salary package with attractive benefits, reflecting your expertise and contribution.
- Work in a growth‑oriented industry with strong demand for energy‑efficient and industrial solutions, offering long‑term job security and career development opportunities.
- Join a diverse, international team where different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences are valued. We are committed to an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, nationality, or other personal characteristics.

Your Background

- Degree in Engineering, Business, Production Technology, or a comparable field.
- At least 3 years of experience in Lean, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence in an industrial environment.
- Solid knowledge of Lean tools and methods (Six Sigma a plus); strong MS Office skills and basic ERP experience.
- Experience with tools such as MS Planner, Visio, Lucidchart, or Power BI is an advantage.
- Excellent communication skills in English and German, team‑oriented mindset, hands‑on attitude, and strong analytical and solution‑driven thinking.

Join Kelvion in Herne and help us build a more efficient, agile, and sustainable production environment on a global scale. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Doctoral Researcher / PhD Candidate (f/m/x) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
We are looking to support our rapidly growing team as soon as possible: Doctoral Researcher / PhD Candidate in Immunotherapy of Viral Infections (f/m/x)

Institute of Virology - Laboratory of Experimental lmmunology
TV-L: 25 h/week (64,94%)
Fixed-term employment for 3 years under the German Academic Fixed-Term Contract Act (WissZeitVG) for the purpose of pursuing a doctoral degree (PhD)
Your salary will be based on TV-L

Your tasks

• Contribute to research projects investigating broadly neutralizing antibodies (bNAbs) to effectively target HIV-1 in vivo
• Design and evaluate AAV-based gene vector strategies for in vivo delivery of bNAb combination therapy
• Establish multispecific antibody-derived protein constructs to target the HIV-1 envelope protein
• Investigate bNAb expression, antibody-mediated virus neutralization in vitro and in vivo, and pathways of viral immune escape
• Plan, perform, and analyze experiments under scientific supervision using state-of-the-art approaches in immunology, virology, and molecular biology
• Establish, optimize, and apply immunological and virological assays, including cell culture, flow cytometry, ELISA, neutralization assays, molecular cloning, and next-generation sequencing
• Perform experiments using infectious viral material in vitro and in vivo (humanized mice) in biosafety level S3 environments
• Collaborate with national and international research partners in an interdisciplinary research environment
• Present research findings at scientific meetings and conferences, and prepare scientific manuscripts
• Maintain detailed experimental records and ensure high standards of scientific quality, reproducibility, and documentation

Your profile

• Excellent university degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in biology, biomedicine, immunology, virology, molecular medicine, or a related life science discipline
• Strong interest in translational research at the interface of immunology, virology, and infectious diseases
• Hands-on experience with immunological and molecular biology methods (e.g., cell culture, flow cytometry, ELISA, PCR, cloning, or sequencing technologies) as well as experience working with small animal models are advantageous
• Willingness to conduct experiments using HIV-1-infected humanized mouse models (existing FELASA certification is beneficial)
• Prior experience in virology, antibody research, B cell biology, or HIV research is beneficial but not required
• Independent, structured, and detail-oriented approach to scientific work based on high personal scientific standards
• High level of motivation to independently address complex scientific questions and develop creative as well as innovative solutions for scientific problems
• Strong teamwork and communication skills, as well as enthusiasm for working in an interdisciplinary and international research environment
• Excellent written and spoken English

Our offer

• Participation in a highly modern and internationally connected research project with strong scientific and societal relevance
• An excellent scientific environment within a dynamic and interdisciplinary team
• Access to state-of-the-art technologies and laboratory infrastructure within the new “Translational Research for Infectious Diseases and Oncology (TRIO)” research center
• Close scientific supervision and support for your professional and personal development
• Opportunities to participate in national and international conferences and to publish scientific findings
• Challenging and diverse responsibilities with a high degree of independence and creative freedom
• For further information, please visit www.klein-lab.de
 
Your future with us

We are one of the leading university hospitals in Germany and network research, teaching and health care at the highest level. That's why many things are a lot bigger for us: the spectrum of exciting development opportunities. The limitless openness with which specialists from all over the world work together here. Or our commitment as an employer to support all employees as best we can in reconciling their job with their goals and life situations.
This is the University Hospital of Cologne: Everything but ordinary.

Your future in detail

We are a dedicated translational research group focused on understanding the fundamentals of human immune responses to viral pathogens and on developing novel strategies for the prevention and treatment of infectious diseases. Our work combines cutting-edge immunology, virology, antibody engineering, and translational research approaches to address clinically relevant questions in viral infections.
This PhD project focuses on the investigation of AAV-based strategies to effectively target HIV-1 using broadly neutralizing antibodies. A central goal of the project is to develop novel approaches for enabling in vivo expression of bNAb combinations that overcome limitations of AAV packaging capacity. The project will involve the design and detailed characterization of multispecific bNAb-derived constructs, the in vivo validation of AAV-mediated protein expression, and the analysis of antiviral activity as well as viral evolution in HIV-1-infected humanized mouse models. The successful candidate will work in a highly collaborative environment with access to state-of-the-art laboratory infrastructure and clinical research networks.
Your work will contribute to a deeper understanding of antibody activity against HIV-1 as well as viral escape mechanisms, and support the development of innovative preventive and therapeutic strategies.
Applications from female candidates are expressly welcome and will be given priority in the event of equal suitability, competence and professional performance. People with disabilities are welcome to apply and will be treated preferentially in the event of equal suitability and qualification.

jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) is a
joint venture between four technology leaders, TSMC, Bosch, Infineon
and NXP, to establish a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in the
heart of Europe. ESMC represents our shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. To help us build
the foundation of our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a
highly motivated and passionate (m/f/d): Senior Equipment Hook-Up
Engineer As a Senior Equipment Hook-Up Engineer, you will be
coordinating all hook-up activities from planning, construction, and
commissioning of faculty media supplies (gases, chemicals, exhaust
air, ultra-pure water, wastewater, electricity) from the base build
supply connection to the process equipment at our new state-of-the-art
semiconductor fab in Dresden. Your role will ensure system safety,
reliability, efficiency, and compliance while driving continuous
improvement and innovation. You will collaborate with internal teams
and external service providers. Tasks New challenges: Become part of
the facility team to build ESMC's 300mm semiconductor fab. System
Ownership & Optimization: Develop and manage detailed schedules for
equipment hookups, coordinating with equipment vendors, construction
teams, contract vendor management, and facility engineers to ensure
seamless integration in compliance with environmental and safety
regulations. Technical Expertise: Review and approve hookup designs
and engineering plans, ensuring compliance with industry standards and
project specifications. Experience in electrical, process colling
water, ultra-pure water, Gas & Chemical, and other Plastic utility
systems. Data-Driven Decision Making: Monitor and report on the
progress of hookup activities to senior management, addressing any
issues or delays proactively. Project Involvement: Support system
design, construction, and commissioning for new facility installations
and upgrades. Continuous Improvement & Cost Optimization: Plan,
coordinate, and execute strategies to accelerate hookup progress.
Identify opportunities for cost savings, reliability improvements, and
integration of best practices. Collaboration: Lead a team of
technicians and contractors, providing guidance, training, and
performance evaluations. Communicate with cross function engineers or
venders. Profile Job Qualifications: Qualifications and Education:
Degree in Electrical, Chemical, Mechanical or Automation Engineering
or a related field Must have experience: 10+ years of experience in
equipment hookup or facility engineering within the semiconductor
industry. Proven track record in managing large-scale construction or
installation projects. Familiarity with semiconductor fabrication
processes and equipment. Language Skills: Fluent German and English
language skills. Professional Skills: Proficient with Microsoft
Office, discipline-specific software (i.e., AutoCAD, Revit, etc.).
Personal Attributes: Strong analytical thinking and highly effective
interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others.
Location: Dresden, Germany. What we offer Each journey starts with a
first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the
unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden,
boost your career and unlock your potential. Work in a fast paced,
international startup environment while at the same time having access
to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most
advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. At ESMC, we
create an inclusive environment to inspire passion and enable the best
in YOU. It is the policy of ESMC to provide equal employment
opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, ethnic and
national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability,
race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender
identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status,
status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other
characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Contact
Please apply with English resume

jobs.occupation: Quality Management & Document Control Engineer (m/f/d) (Qualitätsmanager/in)
jobs.description:
About us Die European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
ist das Joint Venture von TSMC, Bosch, Infineon und NXP. Erstmals
errichtet der weltweite Technologieführer TSMC eine Halbleiterfabrik
im Herzen Europas, die kleinste Fertigungstechnologien für
Halbleiterprodukte der nächsten Generation bietet. ESMC steht für
das gemeinsame Engagement zur Stärkung des europäischen
Halbleiter-Ökosystems. Für unsere zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen
wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und engagierte/n: Quality Management &
Document Control Engineer (m/f/d) Are you ready to shape the quality
standards of a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab from the ground up?
As a Quality Management & Document Control Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC,
you will bridge the gap between our Taiwanese headquarters and our
brand-new greenfield facility in Dresden. Starting on January 2027,
you will own the Document Control System, ensure compliance with
international quality standards, and coordinate internal, customer,
and third-party audits. By running trainings and cross-departmental
programs, you will champion a proactive quality culture across the
Fab. If you are a detail-oriented professional with initial QA
experience looking to make a lasting impact on Europe’s
semiconductor ecosystem, we want you on our team! Tasks System
Ownership: Administer and maintain the site-wide Document Control
System (DCS) to guarantee database integrity, document effectiveness,
and smooth annual document review processes. Audit Management:
Independently plan, execute, and follow up on internal quality audits,
customer audits, and third-party quality system certifications.
Continuous Improvement: Track and drive the implementation of
corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) resulting from audits and
quality reviews. Promote Quality Culture: Collaborate with the Fab
engineering and manufacturing teams to develop and host
quality-related training sessions, workshops, and symposiums. HQ
Collaboration: Leverage resources, documentation standards, and best
practices from our headquarters to build a reliable local quality
framework. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all document management and
quality processes comply with German/European regulations, customer
requirements, and standard quality frameworks. Profile Must-Have:
Education: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Engineering, Natural
Sciences, Quality & Reliability, or a related technical field.
Experience: 1 to 3 years of professional experience in the
semiconductor, automotive, or highly regulated electronics
manufacturing industries with a focus on Quality Systems (QS) or
Quality Assurance (QA). Methodology & Tools: Solid familiarity with
standard Quality Control tools, 8D problem-solving methodologies, and
core automotive quality tools (such as SPC, MSA, FMEA, APQP, PPAP).
Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) for daily
international collaboration. Working Style: Highly organized,
detail-oriented, and resilient under pressure in a fast-paced
environment. Nice-to-Have: Initial experience or certified
qualification as an auditor (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or VDA 6.3).
Basic programming/querying skills in SQL (Structured Query Language)
for quality data extraction. Familiarity with the local German
business ecosystem and manufacturing regulations. Basic conversational
skills in German and/or Mandarin. We offer Help build a completely new
semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe. Work in a highly
international environment with colleagues across Europe, Taiwan and
the US. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures.
Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.
International onboarding including approximately 9-12 months of
training in Taiwan. Additional contact details Please apply with your
English resume.

jobs.occupation: Research Associate / Project Coordinator (m/f/d) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (19.915 hours/week = 50%) January 01, 2027, we are looking for a

Research Associate / Project Coordinator (m/f/d)

The Department of Health Services Research at the Institute of Diversity Medicine, Faculty of Medicine, Ruhr University Bochum, Germany, is seeking to appoint a Research Associate / Project Coordinator (m/f/d) starting 1st of January 2027. The Department of Health Services Research investigates how individual diversity characteristics influence healthcare delivery and develops, implements, and evaluates innovative, patient-centred models of care. Our research focuses on the evaluation of complex interventions, participatory health services research, and the development of diversity-sensitive healthcare concepts. Our interdisciplinary work integrates health services research, public health, social sciences, and medical ethics.

The successful candidate will join the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Programme DIME – Diversity Medicine, an international initiative to establish a new joint Master's programme together with leading European and international partner universities (e.g. France, Japan, Taiwan). This position offers the unique opportunity to contribute to the development of an innovative international degree programme at the intersection of diversity medicine, global health, and higher education. As Research Associate / Project Coordinator, you will play a central role in coordinating this international consortium. You will collaborate closely with academic partners, university leadership, teaching staff, students, and funding organisations across several countries. The position requires excellent English proficiency, strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills, and outstanding organisational abilities to successfully coordinate complex international collaborations.

Scope: part-time
Duration: fixed-term, 15 Monate
Start: January 01, 2027
Apply by:  2026-09-28

Your tasks:

- Contribute to the scientific development and evaluation of the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Programme DIME - Diversity Medicine, including literature reviews and the preparation of scientific materials
- Support the collection, analysis and interpretation of data related to teaching, programme evaluation and research activities within DIME
- Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations and the dissemination of research findings
- support the coordination of academic activities within DIME, including communication with partner universities, students and visiting academics
- Assist in organising consortium meetings, workshops and selected international programme activities conducted in English
- Contribute to project documentation, reporting and the preparation of presentations and other project materials

Your profile:

- Master's degree (or equivalent university qualification) in Public Health, Health Sciences, Medicine, Health Services Research, Social Sciences, Psychology, Medical Ethics, Higher Education Management, or a related field
- Strong interest in diversity medicine, international higher education, and collaborative research
- A very good command of written and spoken English is essential, as English is the working language of the consortium and virtually all communication is conducted in English
- Excellent communication, networking, and interpersonal skills
- Outstanding diplomatic skills, intercultural competence, and confidence in working with partners from diverse academic, cultural, and professional backgrounds
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to independently manage complex international coordination processes
- Highly structured, proactive, solution-oriented, and reliable working style with a strong sense of responsibility
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within an international team
- Experience in international project management, Erasmus+, Erasmus Mundus, university administration, or comparable international projects is desirable
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications

jobs.occupation: Research associate (m/f/x) in Data Science in Chemistry (Analytiker/in - Chemie)
jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for a

Research associate (m/f/x) in Data Science in Chemistry

At the Chair of Inorganic Chemistry II of the Ruhr University Bochum we address research questions in the fields of organometallic synthesis chemistry and homogeneous catalysis. We are an internationally oriented research team that develops new reagents as well as highly efficient catalysts for synthetic chemistry. By combining advanced synthetic methods, state of the art analytical techniques, quantum chemical calculations, and machine learning methods, we conduct world leading research at the highest international level. Automated analysis of chemical data and the prediction of reactivity, selectivity and yield by means of machine learning are revolutionising modern chemistry. In our group we employ data science methods together with quantum chemical calculations to model reaction networks from experimental data, understand bonding situations and reactivities, and identify new catalysts and reaction conditions in a data driven way.

The Chair of Inorganic Chemistry II (Organometallic Chemistry and Homogeneous Catalysis) is looking for a full time scientific staff member (postdoctoral researcher) (100 % TV L 13) to start immediately. We are looking for a motivated postdoctoral researcher (m/f/x) who, with a passion for interdisciplinary work, will support the design of teaching courses in data science and machine learning and strengthen our group in this area.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 Jahre
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-09-21

Your tasks:

- Quantum‑chemical calculations – perform calculations to elucidate reaction mechanisms, bonding situations and to extract physicochemical properties of molecules
- Model development & validation – create and validate models that clarify structure‑activity relationships and predict properties and reactivities; analyse data with statistical methods and visualise the results
- Collaboration with experimentalists – work closely with laboratory scientists to support and validate data collection
- Project leadership – take responsibility for projects, supervise students, write reports and grant proposals
- Scientific communication – compile results into publications and assist students in preparing manuscripts
- Mentorship – supervise students in their theses and support teaching activities in the areas of Data Science and Machine Learning
- Teaching – support the development and implementation of new student courses in Data Science and Machine Learning

Your profile:

A candidate with a completed university degree and a PhD (preferred) in Chemistry is sought; candidates from related fields such as Data Science or Computer Science with demonstrable knowledge of chemistry are also welcome.

Further requirements:

- Practical experience in quantum‑chemical calculations – familiarity with common quantum‑chemical programs and methods, in particular ORCA, Multiwfn, AIM, etc.
- Practical experience in machine learning & chemistry‑specific data science – programming skills in Python and hands‑on experience with standard libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Scikit‑learn, RDKit, PyTorch, etc.
- Practical experience in homogeneous catalysis – desirable, but not mandatory
- Practical experience with the installation and maintenance of high-performance computing clusters – desirable, but not mandatory
- Theoretical knowledge in quantum-chemistry, machine learning, molecular chemistry
- Experience in research project management
- Experience in publishing and presenting scientific results
- Experience in teaching and the supervision of students and interns
- Language skills – English (fluent spoken and written) is required; German is an advantage but not mandatory

Furthermore, the applicant should be open to team‑oriented work and possess a strong motivation for interdisciplinary research.
